hana_cs: Heads-up — NimbleCart onboarding is stalling: their QA sees 5xx spike then 429s when running the JS quickstart. Theyre on a weekend ramp and worried about their renewal check-in next week. Account nim-5592.

hana_cs: Paste from their console:```
[2026-03-22T22:10:02Z] POST /v1/generate -> 503
[2026-03-22T22:10:04Z] POST /v1/sessions -> 429 x-ratelimit-remaining:0 x-ratelimit-window:60
browser: fetch failed: TypeError: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource
```

diego_eng: Are they using the embed flow + client-side ephemeral per-component? Common anti-pattern: creating a new ephemeral for each widget instance on page load. Quick ask: how many concurrent connections per client and are they using keepalive or re-authing per request?

lucy_devex: Immediate fixes to propose to customer: 1) Single ephemeral per session (store in sessionStorage), 2) debounce component init so widgets init serially on first page load (200-400ms gaps), 3) soft fallback that shows cached state if preflight fails twice, 4) add Retry-After handling to pause attempts. Tiny sample snippet:```
// store token once
if(!sessionStorage.ephemeral){ sessionStorage.ephemeral = await mintEphemeral(); }
// simple backoff
async function callWithBackoff(fn){ for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ try{return await fn();}catch(e){ if(e.status!==429)throw e; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, 200*(2**i) + Math.random()*300)); }} throw new Error('max retries'); }
```

ops_support: I'll pre-approve a transient quota increase while they patch client. Applying +25% quota to nim-5592 until 2026-03-24T06:00:00Z. Logged as CASE-10005. Also flagging their CSM: this looks like a potential renewal risk if onboarding slips.

hana_cs: Noted — I'll open a calendar invite for a 20m troubleshooting call with a checklist: (A) share browser HAR, (B) show token issuance code, (C) confirm peak req/min target.

diego_eng: If HAR shows many /v1/sessions calls from multiple frames, that's the cause. We can also suggest using a shared ServiceWorker to centralize token + request coalescing if they want a longer-term solution.

lucy_devex: Gathering customer feedback: please ask NimbleCart how confusing the starter instructions were on ephemeral tokens; we'll capture that in the onboarding retro. If they want, we can create a one-click sample that uses sessionStorage + worker to avoid this class of mistakes.

kubebot: deploy:temporary-quota nim-5592 +25% until 2026-03-24T06:00:00Z by ops_support.

hana_cs: Sending the patch suggestions and offering a 20m slot. I'll include a short survey after call to capture their onboarding pain points for retro and flag to product docs. Thanks team. :pray:
